arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Please treat the gas smell seriously, even if it only happens sometimes. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any flames or light switches near it. Open the windows, leave the flat if you can smell gas now, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). If anyone feels unwell or you're in immediate danger, call 999. We're arranging for a Gas Safe engineer to be sent as an emergency, and we'll be in touch about it. Please don't use the oven until it has been checked.
